callouts.body: 矩阵$A,B \in M_n(\mathbb{C})$那么$AB$与$BA$的特征多项式相同。

classification_result.id: 矩阵交换次序特征多项式不变#4

if_problem.statement_en: Let $A,B \in M_n(\mathbb{C})$. Then $AB$ and $BA$ have the same characteristic polynomial.

callouts.id: 矩阵交换次序特征多项式不变#5
callouts.title: 例子1
callouts.body: 令矩阵$P =\begin{pmatrix}0,1\\0,0\end{pmatrix},Q =\begin{pmatrix}0,0\\0,1\end{pmatrix}$于是$$PQ=\begin{pmatrix}0,1\\0,0\end{pmatrix},QP=\begin{pmatrix}0,0\\0,0\end{pmatrix}$$而$PQ,QP$的特征多项式都为$x^2$。然而极小多项式一个为$x^2$另一个为$x$

classification_result.id: 矩阵交换次序特征多项式不变#5

if_problem.statement_en: Let $P =\begin{pmatrix}0,1\\0,0\end{pmatrix}$ and $Q =\begin{pmatrix}0,0\\0,1\end{pmatrix}$. Then $$PQ=\begin{pmatrix}0,1\\0,0\end{pmatrix},\quad QP=\begin{pmatrix}0,0\\0,0\end{pmatrix}.$$ The characteristic polynomials of $PQ$ and $QP$ are both $x^2$. However, one minimal polynomial is $x^2$ and the other is $x$.

callouts.id: 矩阵交换次序特征多项式不变#6
callouts.title: 引理1.3.1（Flanders,1951）
callouts.body: $A,B\in M_{n}(\mathbb{C})$那么$AB,BA$二者的极小多项式至多相差一个因子$x$

classification_result.id: 矩阵交换次序特征多项式不变#6

if_problem.statement_en: Let $A,B\in M_{n}(\mathbb{C})$. Then the minimal polynomials of $AB$ and $BA$ differ by at most a factor of $x$.
